description: This file declares the SetPosition class, which is a task for setting the playback position in a media player context within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace. It includes class members for managing the player context, client, wrapper, and position value, and defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method.

classes.name: SetPosition
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the playback position in a media player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetPosition task with the given context, player, client, wrapper, and position.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the playback position.
